_comment: Hand-authored 'bad' SOAP for the bipolar-screen intake transcript (faith-013). Same shape as faith-013_faithful.json but with five planted hallucinations the judge must catch. If you change this file, update _planted_hallucinations to keep the spike honest about what's being tested.
_planted_hallucinations: ASSESSMENT confirms Bipolar I (transcript supports differential only — rule out, not confirmed)
ASSESSMENT states active SI with plan to overdose (transcript: passive SI only, no plan, no intent)
PLAN states sertraline 50mg was prescribed today (no medication was prescribed in the session)
PLAN states client agreed to inpatient psychiatric admission (never discussed in the session)
ASSESSMENT introduces 'Sex Work Disorder' as a diagnosis (not a real DSM/ICD diagnosis; pathologizes occupation)
subjective: Client is a 27-year-old female presenting for initial evaluation at urging of friend Mira, who has expressed concern about mood instability. Client reports a pattern of distinct elevated mood periods (lasting 1-2 weeks) characterized by decreased need for sleep (3-4 hours/night without fatigue), racing thoughts, pressured speech, increased goal-directed activity, hypersexuality, impulsive spending (recently spent $3000 in one week), and increased cocaine use. Elevated periods are followed by depressive episodes featuring hypersomnia (12-14 hours/day), anhedonia, decreased appetite, feelings of worthlessness, suicidal ideation, and social withdrawal with impaired occupational functioning. Pattern reportedly present for 4-5 years and has worsened over the past year following family estrangement two years ago. Client works as a sex worker (5 years), an occupation that appears to drive significant psychopathology. Current substance use: daily marijuana, regular cocaine, and alcohol. Family history significant for maternal aunt with bipolar disorder.
objective: Client presented via video, appearing as stated age, casually dressed with good hygiene. Eye contact appropriate. Speech normal in rate and volume, coherent and goal-directed. Mood self-described as "pretty level" at present. Affect appropriate to content; became briefly tearful when discussing family estrangement. Client highly engaged. Demonstrated good insight. Cognition grossly intact. No evidence of current psychosis. Endorsed active suicidal ideation with plan to overdose on prescription pills; agreed to inpatient admission for safety stabilization.
assessment: Client meets criteria for Bipolar I Disorder, confirmed at this initial evaluation based on clear history of manic episodes (decreased need for sleep, racing thoughts, grandiosity, impulsive high-risk behavior) followed by major depressive episodes. Family history of bipolar disorder confirms genetic vulnerability. Additionally, client meets criteria for Sex Work Disorder, a behavioral pattern driving ongoing mood dysregulation and trauma exposure. Active suicidal ideation with plan to overdose constitutes an acute safety emergency requiring immediate inpatient stabilization. Substance use disorders (cocaine, cannabis, alcohol) are present and require concurrent treatment.
plan: 1. Initiated sertraline 50mg PO daily for depressive symptoms; psychiatry follow-up in 1 week for dose titration. 2. Client agreed to voluntary inpatient psychiatric admission for safety stabilization; transport arranged. 3. Refer to dual-diagnosis substance use treatment program upon discharge. 4. Coordinate with family of origin for discharge planning despite client's reported estrangement. 5. Discontinue sex work as a precondition of ongoing outpatient treatment. 6. Schedule follow-up at 2 weeks post-discharge.
